gaps.sentence: We expect ___ the results by Friday.
gaps.explanation: expect takes the to-infinitive: expect to receive.

gaps.sentence: If you keep ___ like this, you'll exhaust yourself.
gaps.explanation: keep (+ on) is followed by -ing: keep working.
pretend + to-infinitive; negative: not to hear.

gaps.sentence: When I was a student, I used ___ in shared flats.
gaps.explanation: used TO + infinitive = past habit/state: used to live. (Compare: be used to living.)

gaps.sentence: We stopped at a village ___ some lunch.
gaps.explanation: stop to do = pause in order to do something: stopped to have lunch.

gaps.sentence: This new timetable will mean ___ earlier trains.
He went on ___ even after the audience had left.
gaps.explanation: go on + -ing = continue the same activity; go on to do = do something next.

gaps.sentence: I'm sorry for ___ so long to reply.
